特色內容：
- 15 種不同的遊戲模式
- 簡單又欲罷不能
- 極簡主義的視覺設計

Your job as a passionate vet is to examine sick farm animals, make the right diagnosis, treat them accordingly and nurse them back to health.
Build up trust with the small and large two- and four-legged friends so that they soon feel better again. Your help is called for on the farm! 

What awaits you:
• Design your own avatar
• You can get to your missions by car, on horseback or by foot
• Discover the large game world with 3 farms
• Treat over 90 diseases in your practice or on site in the stables

Take care of these cute patients:
• Pigs & piglets
• Cows & calves
• Sheep & lambs
• Horses
• Goats
• Dogs 
• Cats
• Chickens, ducks and geese
• Rabbits

Load up your jelly cannon and take aim!

Launch jellies at targets and smash them to pieces!

Take on moving targets and boss as you try to reach the highest stage you can!

One man and his guns. Become a mysterious Warlock who embarks onto a dangerous mission to eradicate all evil. Put your finger on the trigger and travel through time and space to wreak havoc like in the golden days of fast paced, adrenaline-pumping first person shooters, hooking you for hours of super fun carnage. Let’s rock and roll!

Explore 60 vast levels in five settings, from frozen Antarctic base to the sands of Egypt to the medieval castles’ courts and graveyards. Find keys to unlock passages, reveal secret caches with ammo and gold, use lifts and hidden buttons to access new areas. Finally descend to hell to face the ultimate challenge and emerge victorious.

Combat tons of enemies from flying demons to five-storeys robots, splashing walls and floors with their blood and chunks. Dodge bullets and projectiles, figure out strategies and weapons that work best against each of the nasty villains. Learn their moves and stay one step ahead to survive through the levels. Face megabosses in vast final arenas to complete each world.

Expand your arsenal with new weapons found along your way. From powerful blades to massive guns, collect and develop your favourite gear and master the craft of carnage. Reach into vast arsenal of 38 types of weapons and learn their secret tricks to deliver maximum damage, fast! Grab ammo and spit out series of bullets, walls of flames, and bursts of magic shots to bring down enemies foolish enough to stand in your way.

Develop your hero the way you like, by assigning upgrade points and perks to the favourite skills between each level. Develop and upgrade spells and weapons to create your unique character through the game, and use their powers to master the game in higher difficulty modes.

column4: 益智、策略、桌上遊戲、其他
column8:
這是經典拼圖與盒子和炸彈的動態融合。 當敵人將人們拖到黑暗的巢穴中並在那裡做惡事時，英雄和他忠實的劍總是會來拯救他們。 但是，如果英雄沒有劍，只有大量的熱情和無盡的炸藥供應呢？ 好吧，對他們不利。 穿越迷宮般的黑暗迷宮，不要把自己炸飛！

特色：
-50個糾纏的拼圖關卡
-完成每個拼圖的動作數量有限
-堅不可摧的邏輯定律
-炸彈和爆炸！

column4: 角色扮演、冒險、策略、格鬥
column8: 庫納，一名在火龍部落的男孩。有一天，被統治一切的神--萬內斯召喚。他被任命將失蹤女孩埃斯庫德從天使部落帶回至萬內斯身邊。在他的青梅竹馬--瑞爾，冰龍部落族長的女兒的陪同下，他跟隨著失蹤女孩前往雲下的廣闊世界，尋找神秘和有趣的冒險。

In the vibrant city of Turboville, Speedy, a young motorcycle with a passion for racing, enjoys competing alongside his friends in exciting local competitions. One day, after an impressive victory in one of these races, Speedy is discovered by a former world champion motorcycle, who invites him to participate in the Wheel City Grand Championship. Determined to succeed, Speedy undergoes rigorous training and travels to the big city. There, he faces even greater challenges and meets new friends, but he must also deal with unexpected problems in the urban hustle and bustle.

·More than 25 types of motorcycles
·More than 100 full color backgrounds
·More than 10,000 words that ensure a story of more than an hour
·Fun music that accompanies you throughout the story
·Image gallery to see all the motorcycles in detail


Can Speedy overcome all the obstacles and win the Grand Championship?

column3: Rochester Institute of Technology MAGIC Spell Studios
column8: A chaotic multiplayer party game where the world, and your character, is constantly changing. Battle to keep control of the crown all while That Damn Goat does everything in its (omnipotent) power to get in the way.

column2: Medieval Royal Chess: 經典棋盤遊戲
column4: 桌上遊戲、益智、策略、學習
column8:
你不能把世界分為“白”和“黑”，但棋子是完全的。 選擇一方，向您的朋友挑戰國際象棋決鬥，並在這款流行的棋盤遊戲中挑戰他！ 提前幾步計算棋局，犧牲兵，但救王。 喚醒你作為戰略家的技能，因為只有這樣你才能智取對手並交付將死。

如果附近沒有朋友，則通過選擇三個困難之一與虛擬對手對戰。 您是國際象棋高手還是初學者？ 不管怎樣，您都會找到適合您的國際象棋技能的難度級別！

遊戲特色：
• 與虛擬對手比賽時的三個難度等級；
• 通過Joy-Con™️ 控制器或觸摸屏進行控制；
• 令人愉悅的中世紀風格極簡圖形；
• 您可以在同一台設備上與朋友一起玩！

《午夜幻想曲》是一款童話風的冒險解密遊戲。小男孩在午夜醒來，發現自己的家變成了神奇的魔法世界，他必須探索這個如同夢境的世界，解開一切背後的真相。他一定能找到將一切恢復正常的答案。

- 探索墜入夢境世界的家；
- 與獨特的角色互動，透過對話了解神秘世界的點點滴滴；
- 收集，組合，運用豐富多樣的道具來解開房子裏的謎團；
- 在尋找真相的過程中，面對各種各樣既直觀又富有挑戰性的謎題；
- 細致多彩的像素風格畫面；
- 引人入勝的原創原聲音樂。

Pinball Arcade is the most realistic and comprehensive pinball simulation ever created!\n\nPlay digital versions of over 35 real pinball tables including Mary Shelley's Frankenstein™, Ghostbusters™ Premium, Star Trek™ Vengeance Premium, Mustang® Premium "Boss", Doctor Who Master of Time, Wipeout™, and Tee'd Off™!
在這個擁有30多個關卡的輕鬆益智遊戲中，完滿的拼出漂亮的動漫女生！拼完圖後，你可以在自己的時間欣賞畫廊裏的女孩。

Welcome to the Russian countryside!
Murom is one of the oldest towns in Russia with a population of 106 984, which is located on the left Oka shore. There are many bus routes connecting the town with other villages and bigger cities. The map includes a part of Murom and about a dozen villages in the countryside, so it mostly consists of countryside routes.

These landscapes are worth to be drawn by a famous painter
Russian open spaces are here: huge fields and dense spruce forests are wonderful in different seasons. Summer and winter versions are included so that you can feel the life of Russian countryside even better.Almost all the roads are of tarmac, but there are gravel roads as well. You'll feel the difference when you drive off the asphalt.
There are more than 50 bus stops, around 23 pre-built routes, 5 garages and gas stations. You can also create your own routes and schedules!

Not just a new map, but also improvements!
We re-worked the traffic system so that cars behave more naturally. Turn signals, position lights and headlamps look much better now.New navigation system was implemented: smooth lines and precise positioning won't let you get lost.
For the first time, the surface is considered by physics. On dirt roads, the resistance is stronger, while it's easier to skid in winter.

神秘的搖滾神使宇宙最偉大的音樂家們的靈魂復活, 每個音樂家都會在比賽中成為參賽者,

搖滾之神以節奏為主的遊戲技術與格鬥遊戲技術混合在一起, 從十幾架獨一無二的戰鬥機中選擇 每個戰鬥機都有自己的設計、技術和口琴攻擊 使用你的計算器釋放EX, 特殊動作會造成損害, 終於以毀滅性的超級襲擊結束他們! 音樂軌道將在複雜與困難中繼續增長,

金鑰特性
以這場競爭的節奏為基礎的戰鬥,

3月25日,

超過40首原創歌曲,

宇宙就是你的舞臺 控制12個完全不同的人物 每個角色都有自己的遊戲風格


遊戲模式
故事模式 – 透過分支故事模式跟隨你最喜歡的角色,

校對:Soup

」 音軌編輯器 – 在您最喜歡的音軌上自旋,

^ 本地 & 排名線上多人 – 直接對付玩家...

（以上介紹為機器翻譯）

column4: 動作、角色扮演、射擊、冒險
column8:
九爪子是一款在球場上神奇跳躍的合拍動作遊戲. 冷凍位元提供一系列的T線.

[故事] 學院的徒弟巫師們會遵循失落的"9魔紙"的方式完成每本魔書.

雖然他們沒有經驗,

- 掌握各種神奇的特性
- 解鎖角色、帽子和手杖等元素
- 能提升水平和提升品味的字元
- 和Trine一樣的美麗的田野 和怪獸和有權力的老大打鬥,可以重複
- 線上/本地合作播放(1-4名玩家)

（以上介紹為機器翻譯）

NERF Legends thrusts you into a futuristic, sci-fi world where you’ll come face-to-face with legions of robot enemies and ultimate boss masters. Armed with a wide array of NERF blasters based on their iconic, real-world counterparts, you’ll thwart formidable enemies while being challenged to pull off the most impressive high-flying trick shots across a series of unique and immersive environments. Are your NERF skills up to the challenge to become the ultimate NERF Legend?

• Set in out-of-this-world locations such as Fortress Siege, Jungle Trouble, Ragnarok Showdown, and Spaceport Blastoff! 
• 15 Authentic NERF basters across the Mega, Ultra and Elite lines! Plus upgradable perks & skins to customize your blaster!
• Collect dart powerups such as magnetic push, magnetic pull, seeker darts, and slow to change the tide of battles!
• Enter the gauntlet and go face-to-face against a wide variety of blaster-wielding robots and Nerf Masters
• Use accelerators and trampolines to bounce and fly across the world!
• Use blasters to solve unique puzzles and challenges
• Earn top rewards by beating the Nerf courses
• 4 vs 4 team play or 8 player free-for-all with online multiplayer modes
• Use the character creator to customize your avatar!

《Last Battalion Defense》結合了緊湊的街機射擊、深度策略以及塔防機制。你將在 3 張地圖上指揮人類最後的防線，面對愈來愈強大的 5 波敵軍，管理致命武器系統，並在每波之間升級防禦以求生存。

戰略武器管理

成功的關鍵在於熟練操作四種不同的軍事武器系統：

火砲（Artillery）：高速射擊粉碎步兵。

加農炮（Cannon）：大範圍傷害，對步兵群與裝甲車輛都極具毀滅性。

迫擊炮（Mortar）：以爆炸轟擊遏制敵人推進。

愛國者飛彈（Patriot）：全能型系統，以壓倒性火力消滅任何威脅。

各武器各司其職，讓你打造專屬的防禦佈局。

動態商店與升級系統

在敵軍波次之間，你可於軍械庫管理戰場資源。使用獲得的金幣：

購買新砲塔

修復受損防禦

提升火力

解鎖新防禦位置

每項決策都會影響你的生存。

戰術深度與適應

當防線接近崩潰時，可呼叫空中支援清除戰場、扭轉局勢。
更高級的敵軍更快、更強、更協調，因此你必須不斷調整策略並在正確時機強化武器。

column2: AKIBA'S TRIP: Undead & Undressed Director's Cut
column8:
Fight like a nerd to defend Akihabara from the diabolical Synthisters, artificial vampires that can only be defeated by stripping them down to their bare essentials. 

•Kati Takes Center Stage
Experience the “true ending” of the game’s branching story for the first time in the all-new Kati's Route. When a mysterious and malevolent force slumbering inside Kati awakens, will you be able to do whatever it takes to save her?

•Explore Akihabara
Your battlefield is Japan's electronics mecca circa 2012-2013, with over 130 real-life shops accurately represented. Take side missions from the many offbeat residents of Akihabara, including quests brand-new to the Director's Cut. 

•Stylish Otaku Action
When you’re an otaku, anything from baseball bats to comics to motherboards can be a weapon. Plus, you can target and strip individual clothing items from enemies to add to your own inventory.

•Comes with previously released DLC!
All DLC costumes and equipment that appeared in the original AKIBA'S TRIP: Undead & Undressed are included in the Director’s Cut, so you can hunt down Synthisters in style.

Classic Checkers是一款引人入勝的棋盤遊戲，可幫助您享受這款非凡的棋盤遊戲的真實有趣的遊戲體驗。視覺效果非凡，您也可以立即查看當前得分。如果您希望獲得最佳結果和最佳體驗，也可以旋轉棋盤。
您可以對付具有多個困難的AI來玩經典跳棋。如果您願意，也可以與您的朋友一起玩PVP。如果您喜歡棋盤遊戲並且想要嘗試一些新穎，獨特和酷的事物，那麼經典跳棋就是您可以玩的終極遊戲。您要做的就是親自檢查一下並儘情享受！
特徵：
沉浸式跳棋遊戲
玩PVE或PVP
時尚的視覺效果
無限重玩價值

Did you just wake up in the afterlife? The only thing you know is that you’re tasked with a strange mission - collect all your debts!

Pick all the coins in 30 levels full of riddles, lethal traps, ruthless enemies...and time pressure! 
Be smart, be fast and make the best use of your hero’s assets: a rock-solid head that can crush blocks and some good ol’ explosives.
You also need to take advantage of your environment by pushing and placing boxes in a clever way.

Just like in the golden days of gaming, enjoy some nice chiptune music, silly characters and pixel graphics and challenging puzzle-platforming action.

Until The Last Bullet is a unique combination of an FMV and rail-shooter game in which you navigate the winding halls of an abandoned factory, eliminating waves of bloodthirsty mutants using various weapons you find throughout the game. The dynamic gameplay is enhanced by short, humorous film clips featuring actors.

Through unexplained circumstances, most people have undergone a monstrous mutation, losing their sanity and turning into bloodthirsty beasts stalking the streets.
The main character, Billy, who previously enjoyed a carefree life, has found himself alone and facing the annihilation of humanity.

After weeks in hiding, he finally manages to escape his barricaded home and sets off into the unknown, accompanied by his crush from years ago and a neighborhood veteran he hates.

One day, the girl ventures alone into a ruined factory full of mutants and disappears without a trace. Billy makes a heroic attempt to find his girl without a moment's hesitation.

• Unusual combination of an FMV and rail-shooter game
• dynamic shooter gameplay with numerous enemies to encounter
• various unlockable weapons to experiment with
• two-player co-op mode to shoot the mutants together!

《ACE DRIVER》是 NAMCO LIMITED（現為 Bandai Namco Entertainment Inc.）於 1994 年推出的賽車遊戲。
透過令人屏息的賽道與真實的操控感，體驗賽車的精髓。
根據你的玩家等級選擇車級，一路衝刺通關吧！誰才是真正的 ACE DRIVER！？

“Arcade Archives”系列忠實再現了許多經典的Arcade傑作。
玩家可以改變各種遊戲設置，例如遊戲難度，並且還可以重現那時的街機顯示設置的氛圍。 玩家也可以通過高分來與世界各地的選手展開競爭。
請欣賞成就一代電子遊戲的傑作。

スペースシューティングゲームは永遠だ。

星間戦争末期、混乱が広がり、とあるエリート傭兵の一団は海賊や略奪者のような振る舞いをしていた。そのリーダーは悪名高きネスタ―大佐だ。彼らの最大の戦利品は、間違いなく不毛の惑星をテラフォームするために設計された装置「Shenandoah」だ。ネスターたちはこの装置を使って軍隊を作り、今や既知の星系に大きな脅威となっている。君のミッションはネスタ―を倒し、「シェナンドー」を取り戻すことだ。

主な特徴

·  すべては君次第！　数々の恒星系を探検し制覇する順番は君の好みと気分で決められる。
·  充実した武器システムは、武器をアンロックし後のセッションで使えるようにする。クラッシックな強力武器からスマートな新武器まで様々なウェポンが勢揃い。
·  100近くの敵のほとんどが独特な行動パターンを搭載。
·  ゲームプレイをさらに面白くするため、新しいHPとシールドの仕組みを導入。
·  4人までCo-opプレイが可能。
·  選択できる9機の宇宙船
·  3つのパワーレベルを持つ25種類の武器
·  14レベル
·  10の異なるボス

Frogsong is a heartfelt adventure where it's okay to be small.

Chorus is a little frog with huge dreams of protecting the world. Being a tree frog, however, society expects them to lead a life of religious studies, instead of training to be a warrior. Their small size certainly doesn't help anyone take them seriously, either. Seeking a better life, Chorus moves to Boreala, a village where members of the Defense Guild train under the wisdom of an old veteran. They quickly learn things aren't going to be as easy as they hoped. With a powerful army and a mysterious rumour both on the rise, Chorus needs to discover how they can protect the ones they love - before it's too late.

Explore a beautiful, atmospheric land and fight monsters on your journey to find your place in the world. 

FEAUTRES:
-Friends and foes brought to life in expressive hand-drawn 2D animation!
-Talk to lots of cute and strange characters as you explore the land of Salia!
-Explore five unique areas filled with their own special enemies, villages, and bosses! 
-Upgrade your blade at the blacksmith's shop for stronger attacks!
-Follow a heartfelt story that deals with themes of identity and self love!
-Try to make the world just a little bit better!

Phy embarks on a secret mission to an abandoned planet infested by a hostile hivemind. With the help of her partner Lizz and General Eral, she dives into the depths of the infestation and learns the dark truth behind its origins. Help her find the heart of the hive and put an end to this evergrowing threat.

Kill hordes of nasty bugs and use the experience gained to strengthen your arsenal and body with cybernetic enchantments. The hive will adapt and send more powerful enemies to stand in your way. Shoot them down with your army of drones, or slash them to pieces with your blade and stop the hivemind from growing even stronger!

Features:
- Engaging story: Accompany Phy in her quest against the hive
- Immersive world: Experience 19 hand-crafted cyberpunk levels
- High-tech arsenal: 10 fighter drones to upgrade and evolve
- Melee weapons: 5 powerful swords with unique active abilities
- Rogue-lite progression: Unlockable permanent augments
- Contracts: Complete tasks to earn credits

Will you help Phy defeat the hive and save the cyber age from impending doom?
菌糸天国で一風変わった独創的な冒険を楽しもう。ここでは、非常に奇妙な食事をする菌類が故郷を救う手助けをしてくれる。\nこの戦争で最善の戦略を練り、あなたの論理力が試される新しく複雑なメカニズムを発見するレベルを乗り越えよう。

column2: Mai: Child of Ages - Storms of Time
column8:
The sudden appearance of a floating factory marks the beginning of a new chapter in the story of Mai: Child of Ages.

Explore brand-new dungeons set inside this colossal airborne structure, filled with ancient machinery, moving platforms, and forgotten experiments.


As Mai ventures deeper into its depths, she will uncover secrets tied to the factory’s origin and the mysterious machines that built it.


Face new enemies, overcome environmental hazards, and solve brand-new puzzles as you explore interconnected areas designed to challenge both your combat and platforming skills.


Main Features

· A new story chapter
· New dungeons set inside a massive floating factory and long-forgotten caverns
· Unique level design with vertical exploration
· New enemies, traps, and puzzles
· Lore that expands the game world
· New craftable items

The skies are no longer safe. What lies within the floating factory could change the course of time.

column4: 益智、街機、生活、桌上遊戲
column8:
If you are looking for casual puzzles games this collection is for you ! 9 In 1 Puzzles is a collection of nine casual puzzles games. Simple and easy to play makes this collection a must have for every casual puzzle gamer. 

Features:
- 9 different puzzles games
- Easy and simple gameplay
- Unlockable skins
以經典 Atari 的精神重溫復古遊戲機時代的輝煌，同時體驗令人心跳加速的平台和射擊動作。 通過嚴格的控制、令人耳目一新的遊戲機制、破解復古藝術和令人上癮的配樂，為街機樂趣做好準備。

村に3人の神秘的な少女が現れたという。彼女たちの相手をする勇気はあるかな？彼女たちを待たせることなく、最新のパズルゲーム、Hentai X でヒミコ、キリン、ミズキに自己紹介しよう。


ファンタスティックアート

Hentai Xは、神秘的な女の子たちの世界でパズルであなたを楽しませてくれます。彼女たちの後をついていけば、今まで見たことのないような素晴らしい場所を案内してくれます。魔法使いのヒミコは、新しい小屋を案内してくれるのを待ちきれない様子だが、夜まで待てば、ヴァンパイアのミズキが、誰にも見られない都会の庭園に連れて行ってくれるだろう。


素晴らしい世界！

女の子たちはみんな、あなたにちょっとしたサプライズを用意している。それぞれが新しい場所と素晴らしい衣装をプレゼントしてくれる。レベルをクリアするたびに、彼女たちからご褒美がもらえても驚かないでね。


主な特徴
- 手描きアート
- リラックスできるサウンドトラック
- シンプルなパズルゲーム
- さまざまな難易度
- ユニークな衣装とロケーション

The Strike – Championship Edition combines authentic environments based on real lakes, engaging game play with accurate fish and lure behaviors that creates an immersive fishing adventure. Players can enjoy 3 different game-play modes including Quick Fish, Career and  Invitational Tournament, or compete with friends in mini games like boat races and casting challenges. Players cast, jig, set the hook, and fight as if a real fish were on the other end of the line. The game takes players to some of North America's most famous fishing hot spots and features eleven types of game fish including Largemouth, Smallmouth, Catfish, and Striped Bass as well as Northern Pike and Muskie.
Complete puzzles of pretty anime girls in this relaxing puzzle game with over 50 levels! Once the puzzles are complete, you can enjoy admiring the girls in the gallery at your own time.

Pride Dance Out & Proud is a celebration of Pride events around the world and all things LGBTQ+. Dance your way through the streets of the most iconic cities around the globe!

Move your body in Dance Mode or get ready to change the world in Rhythm Mode. With "Dance Duels'' you can even make hateful bosses bite the dust and turn them into fabulous allies with Prideality! 

You will be leading Parades in important cities all around the world, capturing the exuberance, color and inclusive nature of all Pride Parades. All game modes can be played individually or locally with friends, as well as three difficulty levels (Virgin, Vicious, Queen). 

You will find unique events and characters that reflect every city of the parade. Be loud, be proud and spread the message of love!

Power up your vacuum and suck up the sandmen! 

Take out their legs, arms, body and head and watch them panic! 

Suck them up before they reach you!

column2: Thunder Kid: Hunt for the Robot Emperor
column8:
201X 年，失序的 AI 率領機器人大軍反抗創造者，征服了北美地區的「機器人帝國」，此時戰爭早已席捲幾乎整個大陸。從小作為正義使者培養的「Thunder Kid」被送入對抗「機器人皇室」的戰鬥，以阻止帝國擴張至全世界 !

《Thunder Kid》是一款操控主要角色進行低多邊形 3D 移動和槍戰的動作遊戲，在保留指標性特色的前提下，變更經典類型的視角並新增了子彈地獄元素。身為「Thunder Kid」，您必須奔跑、跳躍並在繽紛多元的 3D 環境中殺出血路，包括森林、洞穴、懸崖和城市景觀等。在融合獨特元素的復古風格中，解決敵對機器人和大量敵人！

特色：

• 以第三人稱視角進行奔跑、跳躍和射擊！
• 享受繽紛的低多邊形 3D 風格。
• 在瘋狂的混合子彈地獄中，躲避敵人攻擊！
• 穿越各式各樣的環境，從城市到森林。
• 隨時重玩已通過的關卡，精進您的技巧！

『Bramble The Mountain King』は、美しい景色の中で繰り広げられる緊迫感あふれる不気味な旅へとプレイヤーを誘います。少年オーレ（Olle）として、恐ろしいトロールにさらわれた妹を救う冒険へと旅立ちましょう。

ブランブルでは、目に映るものすべてが見かけ通りとは限りません。この奇妙な地では、大小さまざなクリーチャーにいつ近づき、いつ隠れるのか慎重に判断することが大切です。森や洞くつには、腹を空かせたどう猛な獣たちが無数に潜み、不注意な旅人を狙っています…

旅の道中で待ち受ける困難や試練に耐えるための力を授ける魔法のかけら「勇気のきらめき（Spark of Courage）」を呼び起こし、 ユニークかつ多彩なバトルで恐ろしいクリーチャーに立ち向かいましょう。ただし、勇気だけではいけません。優しさを忘れてしまうと暗い道へ引きずり込まれてしまうのでご注意を…

特徴
• 勇敢な少年オーレとして、妹を救う冒険へと旅立ちましょう。
• 美しくも危険な世界を探索しましょう。
• 北欧で語り継がれる奇妙な神話上のクリーチャーたちが壮大なスケールのボス戦に登場します。
• 緊迫と興奮の瞬間がハイエンドな美しいグラフィックで描かれます。

你感覺到了嗎？空氣中正瀰漫著一股春天的氣息。

愛多爵士當然可以，他決定漫步在魯魯大陸的四個角落，從城堡到另一個城堡，只為了尋找他一生的摯愛！

你的目標是收集精心挑選過的禮物以送給下一位等待的女孩，同時還要避免變幻莫測的危險、擊退奇怪的生物，這一切都要在最佳時間內完成！

這款遊戲擁有超過40個手遊關卡的平台樂趣，從繩索攀爬和滑牆到跳高和潛水都能讓你玩得不亦樂乎。再偷偷告訴你，愛多爵士還可以憋氣很久很久哦！

現在出發吧，愛多爵士。你做得到的！

• 前所未有的單人動作冒險遊戲
• 超過40關卡的數百個挑戰
• 一群毫無戒備且不懷好意的人在陸地上隨處遊蕩
• 數條迂迴的捷徑、許多的秘密寶藏和黃金蛋
• 亞歷山大•法林斯基的優美原聲帶

Glyph is a cute, physics-based adventure starring a mech-scarab and his trusted guide, Anobi, challenged with rebuilding an ancient civilization buried under the desert sand. Jump, double-jump, smash and glide through the air in this vertical platformer with amazing controls.

The list:
Time trials
Pure platforming
Refine your skill
Original soundtrack
Customizable cosmetics
Explore and solve puzzles
Value for money at 80+ levels
Route planning in open worlds
One-of-a-kind abilities and controls

在《Football Manager 2023 Touch》中，你可以分區規劃關鍵的足球管理領域，掌管世界級大型足球俱樂部。
首先創建個人經理角色，製定獨特風格，然後在戰術板上彰顯你的指揮技術。插入並使用例如 Gegenpress、Tiki-Taka 等最火熱的戰術風格。 
與教練團隊合作，提升球員招募水平。打造一支由全球超級球星和青年才俊組成的夢之隊，不久後你們就能橫掃國內外獎杯。 
比賽哨聲吹響後，你將決定比賽節奏。使用「即時結果」功能加速遊戲進展，或者觀察數字防護棚邊的多臺攝像來分析行動。 
《FM23 Touch》新增眾多功能，包括：
強化比賽日掌控
全新優化的對局體驗可令你更切身體驗比賽。精簡的用戶界面可幫助你完美地把握住戰術時機，沈浸在熱血澎湃的球場中。 
傳達你的消息
全新的「團隊對話」功能可讓大家聽見你的想法。利用來自多方的反饋，捕捉每一種情緒，不論何時都能改變比賽局面。
記載你的職業生涯
你的精彩個人時刻現在將會以更難以忘懷的形式被記錄下來。動態經理人時間軸將會把你的職業成就可視化，並隨著你的登峰造極之路更新。 
重大的歐洲之夜
參與歐洲冠軍聯賽、歐洲聯賽和歐洲會議聯賽等歐足聯俱樂部比賽，與最強歐洲俱樂部同場競技，測試你的水平能力。比賽今年均獲得全權授權。通過升級的杯賽抽簽機製和真實的比賽日品牌，盛大的歐洲足球之夜就在你的指尖之上。
還有更多全新功能正在遊戲中等你來發現。

《SURPRISE ATTACK》是KONAMI於1990年發行的動作遊戲。
從威脅宇宙的國際恐怖組織「BLACK DAWN」的勢力手中奪回太空站、太空梭和月球基地。
當舞台上的所有炸彈都被回收並到達最終位置時，舞台就被清除了。
擊敗關卡boss後，會有獎勵測驗，如果你回答正確，你將獲得獎勵積分。

“Arcade Archives”系列忠實再現了許多經典的Arcade傑作。
玩家可以改變各種遊戲設置，例如遊戲難度，並且還可以重現那時的街機顯示設置的氛圍。 玩家也可以通過高分來與世界各地的選手展開競爭。
請享受為視頻遊戲打造一代的傑作。

column2: The Pig Cow: Horizons of the New Valley
column8:
Rosie struggles with her identity, caught between the world of pigs and her cow-like nature. With the support of her new family, she tries to grunt and enjoy the mud like a pig.

But questions arise, like: Am I more of a pig or more of a cow?

Along the way, you'll discover important lessons about friendship, along with respect for nature and the importance of perseverance.

Join Rosie, Ricky, and Toby in this incredible story, full of adventure, laughter, and learning.

·Kid- and family-friendly game.
·Accessible text and narrative for young readers.
·Dynamic and colorful images inspired by wildlife.
·Ambient music.
·Accessibility options such as text size and volume.
·Educational fun with content that promotes positive values.

They came to take over the Earth. All they’re gonna get is a whooping!

Robo Revenge Squad is a co-op action game for 1-4 players, where everything is a weapon. Fight alien robots using Robos made of everyday objects: fridges, disco balls, baseball bats, and more!


Your mission: kick metal butts

Deploy to the mission area and reach your target. Sounds easy? There are big bad aliens along the way, and their bigger, badder bosses. There are puzzles and special objectives, from cranking carts to demolishing doom towers. And you also have to evacuate!

Meet a worthy challenge in mission-based campaigns that end with boss encounters. 


Arm up and find your playstyle

Do you prefer melee or ranged combat? Will you rely on basic attacks or special moves? Are you a defensive player, or a Leeroy Jenkins? Decide and jump straight into the action, solo or with friends. 

Wreck hundreds of enemies. Deactivate force fields. Set up explosives. Or even go… fishing?! Do everything it takes to liberate the planet. And don’t forget to evacuate once your mission is complete!


Unlock tons of parts & cosmetics

Put the style in playstyle! Level up and unlock TONS of new gadgets, from weapons to special devices to cosmetics. Make your Robo yours, and only yours. 

Unlock new stuff for being a fighter, not for microtran-- Bleh! We won’t even use that word here.

TL;DR: Just. Have. Fun!

column4: 角色扮演、冒險、策略、街機
column8:
Countless heroes have tried and failed to destroy the ancient spell that holds the castle walls. Meanwhile, hundreds of monsters are roaming inside, guarding the sword shards — the last known thing to be capable of defeating the demonic castle owner, thus shattering its magical structure.

Although you are not alone — some help could be obtained from the merchants, who, for reasons not truly understood, offer their services right inside the lair of evil. Though, it seems to be only a matter of time for them to disappear...

Plan your every step carefully, because save points aren't a thing in a rogue-lite game! There is, however, another option. There are two difficulty modes: PAL/NTSC. If the game feels too unforgiving, you can tone down the difficulty, lowering the framerate to 50 (PAL). Note, though, that music and sounds become more evil at the 83% of their original pitch.

Just like in old NES games, you need to input 13 characters to get back to your game session. Still, the powers of evil prevent you from saving anything much more than the artefacts you've found…

Features: 

- Pixel art style graphics inspired by the 8-bit era of gaming.
- Various playable characters with different game styles and more to unlock. 
- Randomly generated castle,  216 rooms to overcome. 
- Old school password system and two difficulty modes that come from retro gaming.

column4: 模擬、冒險、策略、角色扮演
column8:
進入「Heist Simulator 2025」的驚險世界，在這裡您完美執行搶劫的夢想將變為現實。扮演一名技藝高超的小偷，踏上充滿刺激的旅程，將您的野心變成現實。精確地規劃你的行動，用最先進的工具武裝自己，磨練你的技能，成為搶劫的最終策劃者。
- 策劃你的搶劫：仔細選擇必要的工具並製定完美的策略，以確保每個細節都按計劃進行。找出克服障礙的最佳方法並最大限度地提高任務每個階段的成功機會。
- 隱身與躲避：利用你的敏捷性、創造力和狡猾來戰勝無情的執法部門。利用每一個機會擺脫他們的魔爪並帶著你的戰利品逃之夭夭。
- 逐漸增加的難度：隨著您在遊戲中不斷前進，遊戲會逐漸適應，為您提供越來越具挑戰性的體驗。目標變得更加複雜，敵人變得更加聰明和危險，獎勵也變得更有價值。
- 技能和裝備升級：解鎖和個性化各種技能和裝備，例如先進的撬鎖工具、高科技駭客設備和隱身增強功能。

 您能夠戰勝系統並成為搶劫世界的傳奇嗎？風險很高，只有最聰明、最有算計的人才能成功。

Stop King Zarutz and his army of evil undead monsters from taking over the world!

The world is overrun by werewolves, vampires and the walking dead. Humanity has little hope of surviving. 

Monsters intend to take over the world, killing any humans that stand in their way. Unless, of course, they can turn the humans into terrifying beasts themselves.

Night Slashers features seven stages of endless horror action. Destroy mutants at the hospital only to face the Mad Scientist that created them. Wander through a haunted forest filled with werewolves. Even stop a fearsome vampire from feeding on the living.

After fighting waves of zombies, mummies and the Grim Reaper, it's time to infiltrate the fortress of the evil King Zarutz. 

Can you destroy the portals of darkness as the fire of the
underworld threatens to consume you? Or will you perish in the face of your enemies?

Night Slashers also features hilarious bonus games to give you a break from battling monsters. Anyone up for a friendly game of Whack-a-Zombie or Undead Bowling?

With the Real Arcade Feel, Night Slashers is the best spooky side-scroller of the '90s.

column2: 霍格華茲的傳承 Hogwarts Legacy
column8:
《霍格華茲的傳承》是一款沉浸式開放世界動作角色扮演遊戲，其基於由《哈利·波特》系列書籍首先引入的世界。現在你可以控制行動，並在魔法世界中打造專屬於自己的冒險。 

體驗1800年代的霍格華茲結交盟友、與黑巫師戰鬥，並最終決定魔法世界的命運。撰寫你的傳奇。留待後世頌揚。

探索開放世界

魔法世界等待著你。自由漫遊霍格華茲、活米村、禁忌森林和周圍的陸上地區。 

成為你心目中的女巫或巫師

在旅程中學習咒語、調製魔藥、種植植物並照料魔法野獸。進入你的學院、建立關係、掌握技能，並成為你心目中的女巫或巫師。

體驗全新的魔法世界故事

在一個被遺忘的時代中體驗魔法世界，揭開過去隱藏的真相。與山怪、黑巫師及更多生物戰鬥，並面對威脅魔法世界命運的危險反派。

狐狸媽媽能讓牠的幼崽存活下去嗎？

在這個具有生態意識的冒險中，透過地球上最後一隻狐狸的眼睛體驗一個被人類蹂躪的世界。

發現人類的破壞力，因為他們日復一日地腐蝕、污染和利用自然環境中最珍貴和最有價值的資源。 

探索各種3D橫向滾動區域，保護毛茸茸的小動物，餵養牠們，看牠們長大，注意牠們獨特的個性和恐懼，最重要的是，幫助牠們生存。

利用夜晚的掩護悄悄地將你的小動物引導到更安全的地方。花一天在臨時搭建的庇護所中休息，仔細計劃下一步行動，因為這可能是你和幼崽的最後一步。

特點：
• 基於當前的實際問題探索被破壞的環境。
• 狩獵其他動物來餵養幼崽，避免成為獵物。
• 考驗你的生存本能，並參與到情緒化的決定中。
• 尋找新巢穴，以免受自然和非自然威脅
• 照顧你的幼崽，餵養牠們並教牠們新技能，減少牠們的脆弱性。
• 存活下去！

Croc Legend of the Gobbos is the heartwarming journey of an endearing, humble little crocodile equipped with only his iconic backpack and a wiggly butt as he platforms his way across a series of unique worlds by running, jumping, climbing, swimming and tail 
spinning on his quest to rescue his adopted family of Gobbos from the grasp of the evil sorcerer Baron Dante and his impish Dantini hordes.

With its broad appeal and groundbreaking creativity, the original game quickly became a multi-million selling platforming classic, and while the Croc Legend of the Gobbos remaster delivers an authentic gameplay experience that transports players back to the golden age of gaming, it also introduces a roster of modern updates including 
enhanced HD graphics, modern control mechanics with an updated camera, and retro video modes to recreate the gaming experience that charmed us in the 1990s.

Dive into a beautifully recreated world filled with vibrant colors, captivating landscapes, and playful challenges which will ignite your imagination. The Croc Legend of the Gobbos remaster offers an authentic blend of nostalgia and modern gameplay, ensuring a gaming experience that pays homage to the original while inviting a new generation to discover its timeless magic.

The game features 45 levels packed with enemies and bosses, spread across 5 different worlds including volcanoes, ice glaciers, underwater caves and even more...

The Crocipedia

With the cooperation of many of the original team members, Argonaut Games spent over a year tracking down a treasure trove of long-lost development materials in order to create a painstakingly curated digital museum featuring concept character and level 
designs, animation tests, game design documents, rare promotional merchandise, pre-release mix…

Play as one of Empress Eleanor’s Five Knights investigating reports of a rebellious faction and a missing royal. Will you manage to ward off the Fog?


Into the Fray is a fast action-shooter in the vein of Doom and Dark Messiah. The focus is on fast, bloody combat with satisfying feedback and environmental reactivity in a dark Lovecraftian story of civil strife. 

Into the Fray is part of the Skautfold Series and follows Usurper and Shrouded in Sanity but can be played on its own.


Story

The story is set in 1899 on the island of Portland. Take control of Hito, Third Knight of the Empire, to investigate a missing royal and a rebellious faction called the Sons of Washington. Beware the descending Fog and lead the islanders in fending off the rebels and their Eldritch allies!

Gameplay

Explore corpse-filled streets and dank cave systems or cleanse secret underground tunnels of the rituals aiming to grow the Fog’s influence. As you search for a way to stop the ongoing destruction, you're sure to stumble upon some of the deepest, darkest secrets of the island.

Choose from an arsenal of devastating top-of-the-line firearms: hand-cannons, triple-barrel shotguns, as well as prototype weaponry from the great Nikola himself.

Break just about anything, kick barrels of oil and set them on fire, or just straight up give the boot to your enemies and watch them trigger traps. Persistent gore and debris will help immerse you in the world as you rip, tear and explode your way to victory!
『Debug Girl』融合了經典的2D像素ACT、聲畫讀物與DEBUG要素，是一部新穎的RPG遊戲。玩家在遊戲店與高中時代的同班同學·佐倉來未偶然重逢，兩人聊得投機，於是一起策劃了利用暑假製作一部遊戲的主意。她將會擔負起DEBUG的任務，與你無意間埋藏在遊戲裡的無數BUG進行纏鬥，從而提升遊戲的品質。究竟遊戲能否順利完成？你與她的關係又能否發生變化……？

エコと魔法の国：救出、生存、そして繰り返し！

エレメントを操り、闇の女王に挑め！

王女が危機に瀕している？親友が誘拐された？エコにとっては、いつもの火曜日。魅力的でありながらも冷酷な世界に飛び込み、反射神経こそが最大の味方となる。エコと魔法の国は、ハイペースなアクションと奥深いローグライクストラテジーを融合させ、毎回異なる救出ミッションをお届けします。

適応か滅亡か
同じプレイスタイルはもう二度と必要ありません。膨大な武器、神秘的なアーティファクト、そしてゲームの流れを変えるような能力の数々を解き放ちましょう。あなたは鋼鉄の旋風となるか、それとも環境を巧みに操り敵を倒す戦略家となるか？選択はスタイルだけではありません。生き残りをかけて。

ハイリスクな探索
魔法の国は生き生きとしており、常に変化し続けています。神のような力を与える古代の遺物を発見するか…それとも、恐ろしい呪いを引き起こすか。あらゆる場所に秘密が隠されており、その秘密はギャンブル。あなたはルーン文字を解読する勇気がありますか？

気に入る理由：
- アドレナリン全開の戦闘：完璧な回避をマスターし、強力な属性コンボ（火、水、その他）を繰り出しましょう。
- 無限の多様性：ランダムに生成されるレイアウトと数百通りのアップグレードの組み合わせで、プレイするたびに新鮮なチャレンジが待っています。
- 頭脳と腕力：ただ強く攻撃するだけでは十分ではありません。パズルを解くスキルと周囲の環境を駆使して、ダーククイーンの手下たちを出し抜きましょう。
- 魅力的な混沌：魔法のような活気に満ちた雰囲気の中に、厳しくもやりがいのある難易度カーブが隠されています。

球 球 的 的 的


天上最重要的夢想之一 最著名的封女
選擇根, 兩段外表的死亡者 。
其中一幅是遊戲「仙女神」的劇本,
一個規則是「復仇女神」,

無辜地修正了真正的V或修正機器協會 第一次玩書系列來享受最好的遊戲,

（以上介紹為機器翻譯）
在《Out of Line》中玩家將跟著San進行冒險。\n逃離曾經是自己家園的工廠，找尋與協助新朋友。冒險手繪風格的美麗的《Out of Line》世界！

column4: 益智、桌上遊戲、模擬、教育
column8:
Welcome to Passion Puzzle - the best puzzle game ever made!
Get ready for an awesome time in Passion Puzzle, where you'll solve puzzles with cute girls! Are you ready to have fun?

Original Gameplay Mechanics
Unlike all other jigsaw puzzle games, Passion Puzzle features original polygonal mechanics: assemble animated hot girls from various polyhedral figures.

High-Resolution Animations to Enjoy
As you progress through the levels, you'll encounter new and more intricate puzzles that will test your skills and keep you engaged. With a variety of detailed animated artworks to discover, leave all your worries behind and immerse yourself in the beautiful world of Passion Puzzle. Enjoy stunning animations of hot girls!

Key Features:
• Vibrant Art: Enjoy stunning visuals featuring a colorful cast of characters.
• PvP Mode (Hotseat): Play with your friends! Work together to complete puzzles and enjoy a fun cooperative experience.
• Engaging Puzzles: Test your puzzle-solving skills with a wide variety of levels.
• Simple Gameplay: Passion Puzzle's intuitive gameplay ensures that even those new to the genre will feel right at home.
• Relaxing Music: Immerse yourself in the soothing soundtrack that perfectly complements the charming atmosphere of Passion Puzzle, helping you unwind and focus on solving the puzzles.

Start Your Awesome Puzzle Adventure Now!
Don't miss out on the most fun and addictive puzzle game! Jump into Passion Puzzle and start your amazing adventure today!

column4: 策略、桌上遊戲、其他、模擬
column8:
但別眨眼：這不是你熟悉的二十一點。
 在這裏，你可以堆疊“失效/破壞規則”的卡牌，操控牌桌、改寫點數、逼對手梭哈，打出看似不可能的連鎖連擊。

二十一點 · 進化版
與遊蕩在冥界的靈魂對戰二十一點，爲金幣而戰。每一局都是一次通往自由的豪賭：
-構築專屬牌組：把強力卡牌塞滿你的牌堆
-掌控牌桌：扭曲規則、逆轉勝負、把概率踩在腳下
-每次輪迴都不同：解鎖近乎無限的卡牌組合與戰術路線
-收集神器 / 花色 / 詛咒：用代價換取壓制性的優勢
-洞悉對手與自我：聽他們的故事，找到打破循環的答案


附魔（區別於強力）卡牌：讓規則爲你服務
你的卡牌會直接“篡改”二十一點的玩法：
-逼迫對手過度押注、自掘墳墓
-增減點數，讓必輸變必贏
-操控對手牌組，或窺視自己的牌堆
-與對手交換卡牌，把死牌變成殺招
-挖出牌組裏的隱藏組合，一回合連爆到結束


讀懂對手：牌桌也是審判
每次交鋒，對手只會以“手”的形式出現——你看不見臉，但你會逐漸看懂他們：
-通過手牌與行爲，識破他們的真面目
-熟悉他們的打法與詛咒，針對性拆招
-深化羈絆，找出終結輪迴的那一條路
